summary: Capri Holdings filed a routine Form 8-K on September 16, 2026, announcing the appointment of Catherine So as Chief Legal and Sustainability Officer, effective October 19, 2026, reporting to Chairman and CEO John D. Idol. So joins from Tiffany & Co., where she was SVP and General Counsel, with prior roles at Bank of America Merrill Lynch and as an Assistant U.S. Attorney. This is an ordinary executive appointment, not a forced or abrupt departure, so no special-situation classification applies; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations were disclosed.
